title: Working calendars ②: sys_work_calendar objects, calendar service and Setup page
body:
③ maintainer-directed task · Source: maintainer ruling on #35340 (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35340#issuecomment-7000950747; sub-cards approved 2026-11-19 06:03Z 「同意」「都是 p1」).

**Blocked by #35354** (ADR). Ships in the same release as ③ and ④.

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 平台没有地方存工作日、工作时段、节假日和调休。
- **要做：** 建两张日历对象、一个计算服务，并在 Setup 里给管理员维护。
- **不做会怎样：** 公式函数和审批时钟没有数据可读。
- **你要做的：** 无。

## Scope
- `sys_work_calendar`: code, name, weekly working pattern, `HH:mm` working periods per weekday (several allowed), required `timezone` (`valueDomain: 'iana_time_zone'`, prefilled from the org's effective time zone), `is_default` (one per org), `maintained_through` date.
- `sys_work_calendar_exception`: calendar, date, kind (off / on), optional periods, note. One table for holidays, 调休 make-up workdays and shutdowns.
- Packages may reference a calendar by code and seed rows (follow `sys_exchange_rate`, ADR-0144).
- Calendar service: resolve (explicit code → org default → refuse, never fall back to wall-clock); `isWorkingTime`, `addWorkingDays`, `addWorkingHours`, `workingDaysBetween`; computing past `maintained_through` warns or refuses per the ADR; cache with invalidation on writes.
- Refuse periods that cross midnight.
- Setup page to maintain calendars and exceptions, plus import of exception rows.

## Done when
Objects, service and Setup page land with tests (incl. a 调休 make-up Saturday and a National Day week), and ③ ④ consume the service.

## Non-goals
Business-unit inheritance, CN holiday data package, shift rostering.
